plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.intro: Allow another system to order and manage services as the selected customer.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.balanc: The customer receives their own prices. Purchases and renewals use only the same-currency balance; insufficient funds reject the entire transaction.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.status: Change access status? Disabled access rejects all new requests.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.secret: Access saved. Copy the secret now.
AppSecret is shown only once. The new secret is active and previous secrets are revoked. Give it to this customer for secure server-side storage.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.rotate: Saving rotates AppSecret and immediately invalidates the old secret. Coordinate updating the connected system.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.guideI: Connect instances with the public site URL, AppID and AppSecret.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.https: Use HTTPS in production. Never put AppSecret in URLs, browser code or logs.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.connec: Set SITE_URL to the public upstream API origin without a trailing slash. Use the generated AppID and AppSecret with HTTP Basic authentication on every request. Start by reading the catalog.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.respon: Responses contain code, message and data. Only code 0 indicates success. Preserve requestId when handling errors or retrying.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.purcha: Read catalog pages using nextCursor. Discover and fill product configuration, then POST /channel/quotes to freeze a customer quote. POST its quoteNo to /channel/orders. Orders, payments and services belong to the credential customer.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.config: Use the authenticated product configuration and billing-term endpoints below. Read the configuration revision and fields, validate selections through configuration/evaluate, then send configurationRevision, currencyCode and values to billing-terms to obtain a billingTermToken.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.quoteN: Public configuration quotes identify billing terms only. POST /channel/quotes freezes the actual customer price; never put configuration in URL parameters. Amounts use integer minor currency units. Order using quoteNo before expiresAt, or create a fresh quote after expiry.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.renewT: Use your serviceNo from GET /channel/services, then POST /channel/services/{serviceNo}/operations/renew. Success pays from balance and starts the normal renewal flow. Insufficient funds leave no renewal operation.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.retryT: Use one unique requestId (8–120 characters) per purchase or renewal. For timeouts or unknown outcomes, retry with the same requestId and identical parameters. Never change the identifier to retry a write. Different parameters with the same identifier are rejected. Contact the administrator for invalid credentials, top up the same currency for insufficient funds, and reload configuration after product changes.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.noRequ: No transaction requests yet. Purchases and service operations appear here.
error.idc.channel.purchase.invalid: The purchase configuration is invalid. Select the product and configuration again.
plugin.idc-channel.workspace.open.pagina: Continue catalog pages with nextCursor, up to 24 items per cursor page or 100 per numbered page. Filter services by orderNo and pass the last serviceNo as afterServiceNo for the next page. Query operationNo after submitting an operation. Amounts use the currency minor unit. Billing-term previews show ordinary prices; frozen quotes contain the actual customer agent price.
